visualCharacteristics.purpose: side-by-side video items, each with a player, optional icon, heading, description and button

contentPattern.structure: one row per video: video link (YouTube, Vimeo, Brightcove, Vidyard, Wistia or .mp4; an optional poster picture right before it) | optional icon + heading + text + CTA link

reuseGuidance: Use for a set of explainer videos with copy. For one standalone video use embed-video; for a video beside a selling message use columns-feature.
